reason: The hypothesis proposes a new intervention—doping an elemental Cr coating with a small amount of Si to form nanoscale Cr–Si precipitates that block Cr–Zr interdiffusion—which is not reported or suggested in any passage. While the passages separately discuss Cr coatings on Zr alloys, Si benefits in other alloy systems, and grain boundary diffusion, none combine these elements into a single coating design for Zr-alloy cladding, nor do they propose Si doping of a Cr coating to suppress Laves phase formation.
